title: APPROVE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES RECREATION AND PARKS FOR THE PORT OF LOS ANGELES WATERFRONT RED CAR LOAN
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES RECREATION AND PARKS FOR THE PORT OF LOS ANGELES WATERFRONT RED CAR LOAN
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Transmittal 3
Summary
: Staff requests approval of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) and the City of Los Angeles Recreation and Parks (Rec and Parks), for the loan of the Port of Los Angeles Waterfront Red Car (Red Car). The Red Car is an authentic replica of the famous 1908 Electric “Red Car” built in 2003 that served Los Angeles until 1961. The relocation of this replica Red Car, along a second replica and one original, are necessary to allow construction of the 22nd Street Parking Lot Improvement Project. Rather than finding another site to store the Red Cars, loaning the Red Car to a museum allows it to be preserved, appreciated, and used for educational purposes. The proposed MOU is associated with Harbor Department's Strategic Plan Objective 4: Strong Relationships with Stakeholders, Initiative 1, which delivers key LA Waterfront development projects on time and on budget; attracts visitors to the LA Waterfront; and identifies other public investment opportunities. The Harbor Department is proposing to provide Rec and Parks with a replica Red Car to display at the Travel Town Museum (Travel Town), a museum dedicated to California’s railroad history as it pertains to the development of the Southwest Region of the United States, particularly the Los Angeles Area. Travel Town is located at 5200 Zoo Drive, Los Angeles, CA 90027. The proposed term of the MOU is 20 years, commencing on the Effective Date, with two, five-year options to extend. The Harbor Department will be responsible for relocating the Red Car from its current location to Travel Town, including all costs and necessary permitting for the transportation of the Red Car to dedicate location of display at Travel Town. Transportation costs will be funded through the 22nd Street Parking Lot project. The proposed MOU was approved by Board of Recreation and Parks Commissioners on June 18, 2026.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve the Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department and the City of Los Angeles Recreation and Parks; 3) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to the Memorandum of Understanding for and on behalf of the Board; and 4) adopt Resolution No. _____________.
